note: Inter-station peer-to-peer speed-synchronisation pairs. Per the LVD PROJECT TRAINING schematic (Rev.01, 2026-07-24) the synchronised pair is Kidaru IBPS-2 (master, upstream) and Kisiriri IBPS-3 (slave, downstream). Kidaru pumps into the intermediate balancing tank at Kisiriri's suction; Kisiriri draws from it. Keeping the two in step protects that tank from overflow or dry-run.

balancingTank.note: Kisiriri intermediate balancing tank — filled by Kidaru, drawn by Kisiriri; the asset the sync loop protects
